insights:
Analysis of the Bus Operator Platform Dataset

The dataset contains a total of 13,896 events recorded between November 27, 2025 and February 19, 2026. All events fall under the application category, indicating a focus on user interactions with the application rather than system-driven events.

Findings

VOLUME PROFILE

The volume of events is primarily application-driven, with all 13,896 events categorized under application usage. There are no indications of system-driven events (such as push or sync), suggesting that the majority of interactions are initiated by users engaging with the platform.

CRITICAL LOAD

The following events generate the most traffic:

  • viewed_hisab_page: 5,720 events (41.16%)
  • viewed_hisab_bus_detail: 2,306 events (16.59%)
  • viewed_dashboard_page: 1,926 events (13.86%)
  • clicked_hisab_bus_detail_card: 743 events (5.35%)
  • viewed_hisab_trip_detail: 742 events (5.34%)
  • clicked_hisab_trip_detail_card: 720 events (5.18%)
  • clicked_hisab_yestarday_btn: 257 events (1.85%)
  • home_page_load_error: 206 events (1.48%)
  • clicked_nav_drawer_menu: 145 events (1.04%)
  • dashboard_clicked_gps_vistar_se_dekhe_bus_card: 136 events (0.98%)

INFRASTRUCTURE IMPACT

The data indicates significant user engagement, particularly with the viewed_hisab_page event, which alone accounts for over 41% of total events. This high volume suggests that the system must be capable of handling peak loads effectively. Given the total volume of 13,896 events, the platform's scalability needs to be assessed to ensure it can accommodate potential spikes in user activity, especially during peak usage periods.
